record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, compute item counts solely from training interactions and scale history embeddings by 1 + 0.1*clip(log1p(count[item])-median_positive_log_count, -2, 2). Use scale 1 for unseen items, keep padding zero and leave candidate embeddings unchanged. The earlier inverse-frequency scaling regressed; this tests whether a mild positive frequency signal improves recurrent inputs instead. Preserve learned embedding design, GRU topology, history selection, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Store the fixed feature buffer in each checkpoint and reproduce it through the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Test whether a mild positive training-frequency signal improves recurrent history inputs across all four datasets. Scale observed items by 1 + 0.1*clip(log1p(count)-median_positive_log_count, -2, 2), use 1 for unseen items and 0 for padding. Preserve learned embeddings, GRU topology, readout, candidate scoring, loss and optimizer. Checkpoint the fixed feature and restore it during prediction.
